videos.caption: Cream garlic parmesan chicken melt. For the creamy chicken filling : 2 tbsp butter  1/2 cup yellow onion, finely chopped  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced  2 cup rotisserie chicken , shredded  Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  1 tsp paprika powder  1 tsp red chili flakes 1/4 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream  5 tbsp cream cheese  1/4 cup green onion, chopped  1/4 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tbsp parsley, chopped  To assemble  6 sliced bread of choice  1 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded  Butter for toasting  Method: Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken, garlic powder, black pepper, paprika and chili flakes. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes so the seasonings coat the chicken. Lower the heat. Add the cream cheese and heavy cream, stirring until smooth and combined. Fold in the Parmesan. If the mixture is too thick, add heavy cream a teaspoon at a time. Stir in the green onion and parsley. Taste before adding salt. The mixture should be creamy and thick, not runny. Butter the outside of each bread slice. On the inside, layer mozzarella, a generous amount of creamy chicken, more mozzarella and the second slice of bread. Divide the filling and cheese evenly among three sandwiches. Cook over medium-low heat for about 3–4 minutes per side, until the bread is deeply golden and crisp and the cheese has melted. Cover the pan briefly if needed to help the center melt, then uncover to keep the crust crisp. Let each sandwich rest for about a minute before slicing and enjoy. #recipe #garlicparmesan #sandwich #cheese

videos.caption: 🍪 CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE SHOTS 🤎 Cute little chocolate chip cookie shots, perfect for filling with cold milk. Makes 9 cookie shots. Ingredients: • 1½ cups (227 g) all-purpose flour • ⅓ cup (65 g) packed brown sugar • 2 tbsp + 2 tsp (33 g) granulated sugar • ½ tsp baking powder • Pinch of salt • 6 tbsp (88 g) butter • 1 large egg • 1 tsp vanilla paste • ½ cup + 1 tbsp (100 g) mini semi-sweet chocolate chips For the chocolate coating: • 120 g milk chocolate, melted Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly grease the cookie shot mold and inserts. 2. Mix flour, sugars, baking powder, and salt. 3. Melt butter and let cool slightly. Whisk in egg and vanilla paste. 4. Combine wet and dry ingredients, then fold in chocolate chips. 5. Divide dough into 9 balls. Place into the mold and press inserts firmly down. 6. Bake for 17–19 minutes with inserts in place. 7. Trim the edges while warm. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then gently remove inserts and let cool completely. 8. Melt 120 g of milk chocolate and coat the inside of each cookie shot. Let the chocolate set completely, then fill with cold milk and enjoy🤎 #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #dessertrecipes #viralrecipes #christmasdesserts

Cowboy Butter Baked Spaghetti🍝🤠 Ingredients: * Ground Beef * White Onion * Minced Garlic * Worcestershire Sauce * Black Pepper * Kinder’s Cowboy Butter Seasoning * Garlic Powder * Italian Seasoning * Spaghetti Noodles * Pasta Sauce * Butter * Crushed Red Pepper Flakes * Dijon Mustard * Parsley Flakes * Heavy Whipping Cream * Pepper Jack Cheese * Mozzarella Cheese * Parmesan Cheese * Grated Parmesan Cheese Directions: Start by bringing a large pot of heavily salted water to a boil. Add 1 lb of spaghetti noodles and cook according to the package instructions. Drain and set aside. In a large skillet over medium heat, add 1 lb of ground beef. Once the beef begins to brown, add 1/2 of a diced white onion and 1 tbsp of minced garlic. Season with a few dashes of Worcestershire sauce, black pepper, Kinder’s Cowboy Butter Seasoning, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. Mix everything together and continue cooking until the beef is fully browned and the onions are tender. Drain any excess grease if needed. Once the beef is fully cooked, stir in 1/2 jar of your favorite pasta sauce. Mix until everything is evenly coated, then set aside. In a separate large pan over medium-low heat, melt 1 stick of butter. Add cowboy butter seasoning, black pepper, garlic powder, crushed red pepper flakes, a pinch of parsley flakes, and a small dollop of Dijon mustard. Stir until everything is well combined and fragrant. Reduce the heat to low and slowly pour in 2 cups of heavy whipping cream, stirring continuously. Add 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese, 1/2 cup of Parmesan cheese, and 1/2 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese. Stir over low heat until the cheeses are melted and the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. Taste as you go and adjust your seasonings to your liking! Add your cooked spaghetti noodles directly into the cowboy butter alfredo sauce and toss until every noodle is evenly coated. Spoon your seasoned ground beef mixture over the top, making sure to distribute it evenly. Finish with a generous sprinkle of grated Parmesan cheese and a handful of shredded mozzarella cheese. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 25–30 minutes, or until everything is hot and bubbly. Broil on low for the last few minutes for a perfect golden topping. Serve with some garlic bread and a side salad, and enjoy!🤎👩🏼‍🍳 #fyp #weeknightdinner #cookingtiktok #dinnerideas #easydinnerideas

If you need an easy dinner idea tonight, make these sheet pan chicken fajitas.  One of the easiest dinners ever, so flavorful, so delicious, and dinner is on the table in about 30 minutes. Everyone loved it. Ingredients: •4 medium chicken breasts sliced into thin strips (or boneless skinless chicken thighs) •1 large onion sliced •1 green pepper sliced •1 red pepper sliced •1 yellow pepper sliced •¼–⅓ cup olive oil or avocado oil •2–3 tsp salt •1 tsp black pepper •1 tbsp paprika •2 tsp cumin powder •2 tsp garlic powder Homemade Guacamole: •3 ripe avocados •½ onion finely chopped •1 Serrano chili (optional) •½ bunch cilantro chopped •Juice from 2 limes •Salt to taste •Tortillas of choice Instructions: Slice the chicken into thin strips and add directly onto a sheet pan. I skipped parchment paper because I wanted the chicken and vegetables to get direct heat from the pan for extra flavor and color. Slice the onion and peppers into strips and add them to the pan. Season with all the spices, drizzle with oil, and toss everything together really well. Spread into an even layer and bake in a preheated 425°F oven for 20–25 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the guacamole. Mash the avocados and mix with the onion, Serrano chili, cilantro, lime juice, and salt. Give the chicken and vegetables a quick toss, then broil for another 2–3 minutes until slightly charred. Serve in warm tortillas with fresh guacamole, cilantro, and an extra squeeze of lime. #sivanskitchen #sheetpan #fajita #chicken #easyrecipe

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. pumpkin cinnamon roll cookies dough: 1 cup (226g) unsalted butter, softened 1/2 cup (100g) white sugar 1/2 cup packed (100g) light brown sugar 1 whole egg + 2 yolks 1 tsp (4g) vanilla extract 1/2 cup (120g) pumpkin puree 3 cups (375g) ap flour 3/4 tsp (4g) baking soda 1/2 tsp (3g) salt 4 tsp pumpkin spice  *cream together the butter and sugars well then add in the eggs, vanilla, extract, and pumpkin puree. important: press the pumpkin puree between a couple layers of paper towel to get rid of the moisture! in another bowl, whisk the flour, baking soda, salt, and pumpkin spice. pour the dry into the wet and fold to mix. using some plastic wrap or parchment paper. spread the dough evenly. if its too soft and sticky, then set it in the fridge for 30-45 min to firm up a bit. once all flat and even in a large rectangle. spread on the swirl paste (recipe below) as even possible but leaving abut an inch or two on the top. carefully roll into a tight log then set in the fridge at least an hour so that it holds it shape. slice into even pieces and bake at 350 for 12-14 min (time will vary on the size). let cool completely before glazing! swirl paste: 3 tbsp (40g) light brown sugar 1 tbsp (14g) unsalted butter, melted 2 tsp (5g) cinnamon 1/2 tsp (2g) pumpkin spice blend 1/2 tsp (2g) cornstarch pinch of salt *combine everything into a paste and spread on the rectangle flat dough sheet.  vanilla glaze: 1 cup (120g) powdered sugar 1-2 tbsp (15-20g) milk, cream, or water 1/2 tsp (2g) vanilla pinch of salt *mix all together and adjust the consistency with either more powdered sugar or more liquid. brush evenly on the cooled cookies :) #pumpkin #cinnamonroll #cookies #recipe

Ingredients: 2 cups white rice 1 (10.5-ounces) can condensed French onion soup 2 (10.5 ounce) cans condensed beef consomme 8 ounces baby portobello mushrooms, roughly chopped 1 cup grated Pecorino Romano or Parmesan cheese, divided 1 stick butter, cut into 8 pieces 2 pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 1/4 teaspoons kosher salt 3/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon paprika 1 tablespoon chopped parsley (optional) Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Stir rice, French onion soup, beef consomme, and portobello mushrooms together in a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Top with 3/4 cup of the cheese and add butter pieces on top. Season chicken evenly with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika and place on top of cheese and butter. Top with remaining cheese and cover dish with foil. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown, liquid has been absorbed into the rice, and chicken is cooked through, about 20 more minutes. YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Macros (Per Bowl - Makes 4) Calories — 500 Protein — 58g Carbs — 52g Fat — 5g Ingredients 🥣 2 lb or 32oz chicken breast, Raw 4 medium bell peppers (color doesn’t matter) 2 packets of  Fajita seasoning 5-second spray or ~5g avocado oil spray 2 1/2 cups or 600g cooked jasmine rice High Protein Sauce 💪 1/2 cup or 100g nonfat plain Greek yogurt 2 tbsp or 25g sriracha 1/2 lime, juiced Garlic powder How to make: 🧑‍🍳 1️⃣ Start by getting your rice cooking in a rice cooker or pot. 2️⃣ Dice your chicken and bell peppers, then add everything to a bowl with your fajita seasoning and mix until evenly coated. 3️⃣ Lightly spray your air fryer basket with avocado oil spray, add your chicken and peppers, and air fry at 400°F (200C) for about 20 minutes, tossing halfway through, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (75°C). 4️⃣ While that cooks, make your high-protein sauce by mixing together the Greek yogurt, sriracha, lime juice and garlic powder. 5️⃣ Once everything is cooked, evenly divide your rice, chicken and peppers between 4 meal prep containers and finish each one with your high-protein sauce. Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! It’s one of those meals that looks impressive but is ridiculously easy to make! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! All credit to @allyssainthekitchen for this incredible recipe! 🤎 SAVE THIS ONE because I promise you’ll be making it again and again! #SundayDinner #ChickenThighs #EasyDinnerIdeas #HomeCooking #DinnerRecipes

Garlic honey butter ribeye bites with creamy mash and tender heirloom carrots 🥩✨ A 10/10 meal!! - juicy seared steak bites served over creamy silky mash, heirloom carrots, with a heavvvvenly garlic honey butter drizzled over it all.  Enjoy!     Steak bites (makes 2 servings) * 2 boneless ribeyes, about 1–1½ pounds (450–680 g) total * 1 tablespoon avocado oil, 15 ml, plus more if needed * ½ teaspoon fine salt, 3 g, or to taste * ½ teaspoon freshly cracked black pepper * 1 tsp paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder  Garlic honey butter * 4-5 tbsps unsalted butter * 5 garlic cloves, 15 g, minced or finely chopped  * 3-4 tbsps honey, more or less to taste  * 1-2 teaspoons soy sauce sauce * 1 tbsp fresh thyme chopped * 1/2 tsp red pepper chili flakes (optional) * 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, 4 g * Freshly cracked black pepper * Salt, to taste Tender heirloom carrots * 6-8 heirloom carrots, peeled, washed, stems cut * 1 tablespoon avocado oil, 15 ml * Splash of water  * ¼ teaspoon fine salt * Black pepper, to taste Creamy mash  * 6-7 gold potatoes, peeled, rinsed, boiled  * 3-4 tbsps unsalted butter * 1/4 cup heavy cream, more or less for desired consistency  * Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions pinned in the comments  #steak #foodie #explore #recipe  1. Pan sear carrots on medium heat until fork tender. Set aside.  2. Peel, rinse, cut potatoes into large chunks and boil them in salted water until fork tender. Drain and steam dry for 10 minutes.  3. Mash potatoes with a ricer or mixer (on low speed) until smooth.  4. Heat the mash on low heat in a pot adding the heavy cream, butter, salt and pepper to taste. Set aside and keep warm.  5. Trim away any large, hard pieces of exterior fat, pat steaks dry. Cut into 1 inch bite sized pieces, season.  6. Sear the steak bites in batches in a cast iron or skillet over medium high heat for 1 minute flipping each piece over halfway through. Do not overcrowd the pan for even searing. Remove the steak bites and set aside. 7. In the same pan clean off any black residue from the steak, keeping the browned pan drippings. Add the butter and garlic, stirring it around for 1 min on medium heat. Add the honey, followed by the rest of the garlic honey butter ingredients until glossy.  8. Return steak bites back to the pan and continue to cook in the garlic honey butter for another minute or two or until it’s cooked to your liking.

Notice the GarlicDalek T did you? 😏😂 Follow the link in my bio for the link 💪❤️ HIGH PROTEIN HONEY GARLIC BUTTER CHICKEN MAC & CHEESE 9.5/10 — bloody lovely. 😂 Creamy, cheesy mac & cheese with sticky honey garlic chicken. Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

Here's an Italian dish you might not know about. If you've never had gnudi, think of them as the soft, pillowy filling of ravioli, just without the pasta! An aquarium’s filter does far more than keep the water looking clean. It continuously removes waste, circulates oxygen, and provides a home for beneficial bacteria that break down harmful toxins produced by fish and uneaten food. Without proper filtration, ammonia and other toxic compounds can quickly build up, turning a healthy aquarium into a dangerous environment for its inhabitants. A good filtration system helps maintain water quality, stabilize the ecosystem, and keep fish healthy over the long term. While decorations and lighting may catch the eye, the filter is the unseen engine that keeps the entire aquarium alive.

Recipe Name Cheesy Crunchy Beef Tacos Ingredients 1. 1 lb (450 g) ground beef 2. 8 hard taco shells 3. 1 tbsp olive oil 4. 1 small onion, diced 5. 2 garlic cloves, minced 6. 1 packet (1 oz) taco seasoning 7. 1/2 cup water 8. 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 9. 1/2 cup Monterey Jack cheese, shredded 10. 1/2 cup heavy cream 11. 2 oz cream cheese, softened 12. 1/2 tsp paprika 13. 1/2 tsp chili powder 14. 1/4 tsp black pepper 15. 1 diced tomato 16. 2 tbsp chopped fresh cilantro Recipe 1. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium heat. 2. Add the onion and cook until softened, then stir in the garlic. 3. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it into crumbles. 4. Drain excess grease and mix in the taco seasoning and water. 5. Simmer for 5 minutes until the mixture thickens. 6. In a small saucepan, melt the cream cheese with the heavy cream. 7. Stir in the cheddar, Monterey Jack, paprika, chili powder, and black pepper until smooth. 8. Fill each taco shell with the seasoned beef. 9. Spoon the warm cheese sauce over the beef. 10. Top with diced tomatoes and fresh cilantro. 11. Serve immediately while the shells stay crispy. Follow for more delicious recipes!

AI video editor in Claude Code: 3 prompts, from an empty folder to a finished reel. SETUP (once) 1. Get the Claude app (claude.ai/download) and open the Code tab, not the browser. 2. Make a folder "AI Editor" with 3 folders inside: raw, references, done. 3. New chat in Code → Local → Select folder → AI Editor. Needs a paid Claude plan. PROMPT 1: TOOLS You're my video editor. We work in this folder: raw, references, done. Install and verify 5 tools: FFmpeg with libass (on Mac: ffmpeg-full, full path), faster-whisper for word-level subtitles, yt-dlp for references, Remotion, HyperFrames (npm package hyperframes). Check what's installed first. Official installs only (Homebrew, winget, npm/pip), Node.js 22+. Python packages go in a .venv here, Python 3.14 or older: pip install faster-whisper "av<19". Test each for real: burn a subtitle into a test clip, transcribe 5 seconds of audio. Show a table: tool, version, works or not. PROMPT 2: YOUR TASTE Here are reels whose editing I like: [link 1] [link 2] [link 3]. My format: [talking to camera / voiceover]. Download them with yt-dlp into references (for study only). Study each one frame by frame and by ear: pacing, shot length, pause cuts, subtitles, colors, graphics, transitions, music, the first 3 seconds. Take inspiration, but don't copy: no shots, text, logos or brand elements. Write my own style to style.md with exact values. Show it and ask what to change. PROMPT 3: EDIT My new recording is in raw. Edit it using style.md: 1. Transcribe with Whisper, word timestamps. Ask me about doubtful words before burning subtitles. 2. Cut pauses, slips and bad takes, keep the last good take. Check cut points by audio level. Keep pauses that serve the meaning, breaths and word endings. Don't speed up my voice. 3. Word-by-word subtitles in my style. 4. If references/music.mp3 exists, put it quietly under the voice. 5. Graphics only where they help. 6. Export 1080×1920 to done as draft-v1.mp4 plus edit-notes.md. Check the file yourself, then show me. I'll give edits in plain words; save each as draft-v2, draft-v3. No code words. Follow for my own editing style, coming next.

This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Cream chicken over biscuits with loaded bacon green beans! Such an easy comfort food dinner, and the homemade gravy is so good. I served mine over mashed potatoes with Cheddar Bay Biscuits on the side, but you can serve it right over the biscuits, too! Cream Chicken Over Biscuits Recipe Ingredients: 1 rotisserie chicken, shredded 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp all purpose flour 2 cups water or chicken broth 1 tsp chicken bouillon Cheddar Bay Biscuits, prepared according to package instructions Mashed potatoes, for serving Seasonings: Dried parsley Garlic powder Onion powder Poultry seasoning Paprika Directions: Melt the butter in a pot over medium heat. Add the flour and stir well, letting it cook for about 2 minutes. Pour in the water or chicken broth and stir until smooth. Season to taste with parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, poultry seasoning, and paprika. Stir in the chicken bouillon and give everything a good stir. I skipped adding salt because the bouillon was salty enough! Let the gravy simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally, until it starts to thicken. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken and stir until everything is combined. Cover and let simmer for several minutes until the chicken is heated through and the gravy thickens to your liking. Prepare the Cheddar Bay Biscuits according to the package instructions. Serve the chicken gravy over mashed potatoes with biscuits on the side, or spoon it right over the biscuits! Loaded Bacon Green Beans Recipe Ingredients: 2 cans green beans, drained 2 slices thick cut bacon, chopped 1 tbsp butter 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp low sodium soy sauce Garlic powder Black pepper Directions: Cook the chopped bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy. Leave the bacon and bacon grease in the pan, then add the butter, drained green beans, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper. Stir everything together, cover, and cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, while you prepare the rest of dinner. Let the flavors come together until the green beans are tender! Save this one for your next weeknight dinner! #EasyDinnerIdeas #DinnerRecipes #WeeknightDinner #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe

🔥 Homemade Chicken Arayes in Pitta Bread 🫓  Crispy, golden pitta breads stuffed with juicy, flavour-packed chicken mince, fresh herbs, garlic and a delicious blend of spices… finished in the oven and served with my homemade garlic & herb sauce! 🤤 Honestly, the perfect combination! These homemade chicken Arayes are so easy to make, packed with flavour and perfect for a quick lunch, easy dinner or sharing platter. Think crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside and full of those fresh, herby flavours! 😍 ✨ Ingredients 🛒 * Chicken mince * ½ white onion, finely chopped * Spring onions, chopped * Fresh parsley & dill * Fresh garlic * Salt & black pepper * Paprika * A drizzle of oil * Chilli flakes (optional 🌶️) * Pitta breads 👩‍🍳 Method 1. Add the chicken mince to a bowl with the finely chopped onion, spring onion, parsley, dill, fresh garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, a drizzle of oil and optional chilli flakes. Mix everything together until well combined. 2. Cut the pitta breads in half and carefully stuff each pocket with the chicken mixture, spreading the filling evenly. 3. Heat a little oil in a skillet and place the stuffed pitta breads face down. Cook for a few minutes until the bread starts to turn golden and crispy. 4. Mix some oil with dried mixed herbs, salt and black pepper, then brush over the outside of the pitta breads while they’re still in the pan. 5. Transfer the oven-safe skillet to a preheated oven at 180°C for around 10–15 minutes, keeping the pitta breads face down. Cook until the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre and is fully cooked through. If your pan isn’t oven-safe, transfer them to a baking tray. 6. Remove from the oven, let them rest briefly and serve hot with your homemade garlic & herb sauce for the ultimate flavour combination! 🧄🌿 🌶️ The best part? You can make these any way you like to suit your own taste buds! Add extra chilli for a spicy kick, switch up the herbs, experiment with your favourite spices or try different dipping sauces. Make them your own and get creative with the flavours! Simple ingredients, big flavours and the perfect homemade fakeaway! 🤌✨ #arayes #recipes #quickrecipes #dinnerideas #dinner

Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

High-Protein Green Spaghetti + Chicken 🥘  Easy 5-day meal prep  Per Serving💪: ~535 calories | 54g protein | 49g carbs Ingredients⬇️ * 3 poblano peppers * 2 garlic cloves * ½ white onion * Cilantro, to taste * 8 oz Philadelphia 1/3 Less Fat Cream Cheese * 1 cup LACTAID 1% Lowfat Milk * 2 tbsp chicken bouillon * 8 oz Barilla Protein+ Spaghetti * 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast * 1 tbsp olive oil Chicken seasonings * Garlic salt * Onion powder * Black pepper * Italian herbs Instructions ⬇️ 1. Roast the poblanos  Air fry 3 poblano peppers at 400°F for 10 minutes. Place them in a bag and let them sweat. Once softened, peel off the skins and remove the seeds. 2. Cook the pasta  Cook 8 oz Barilla Protein+ Spaghetti according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 3. Make the green sauce Add the roasted poblanos, 2 garlic cloves, ½ white onion, 1 cup LACTAID 1% milk, 8 oz cream cheese, cilantro to taste, and 2 tbsp chicken bouillon to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. 4. Combine the sauce + pasta Heat a large pot over medium heat and pour in the green sauce. Once warmed through, add the cooked spaghetti and mix until evenly coated. 5. Prep the chicken  Slice 2 lb chicken breast into thinner pieces for even cooking. Season with garlic salt, onion powder, and black pepper. 6. Cook the chicken Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Cook the chicken until fully cooked through (165°F internal temperature), then finish with Italian herbs. 7. Meal prep  Divide the green spaghetti and chicken evenly between 5 containers Save this for your next meal prep! 🤍 #fyp #mealprep #healthy #gymmotivation #inspo

VIRAL CRISPY PASTA SALAD 🥗 Here’s a new way to make your pasta salad. I just had to try it. Full Recipe in Caption  3 cups cooked pasta (fusili) 2 tablespoon olive or avocado oil  1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 1/4 cup freshly grated parmesan For the dressing: ½ cup plain yogurt 2 garlic gloves (minced) 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano  1 tablespoon chopped parsley  2 tablespoon olive oil  3 tablespoon red wine vinegar  1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 1/3 cup  chopped pepperoncini  1/4 cup chopped olives 2 cups chopped romaine 1/4 cup minced red onion  1 cup sliced cherry tomatoes 1 cup sliced cucumber  1️⃣ 	Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add the pasta and cook until al dente, about 10 minutes.  Drain and toss with oil, garlic powder, salt and Parmesan. Air Fry at 400 for 18-20 mins or u til crispy and golden (Make sure to shake the basket every 5 mins to prevent the pasta from sticking together) Set Aside.  2️⃣ In a bowl, add the yogurt, red wine vinegar, dried oregano, garlic, onions, pepperoncini, olives, parsley, olive oil, salt, pepper. Mix well.  Add the romaine lettuce, cucumber, cherry tomatoes and the crispy pasta. Toss until well combined, serve and Devour!  Oven method: Spread the tossed pasta in a single layer on a parchment lined baking sheet and bake at 400°F for 30 minutes, tossing halfway through #crispy #pasta #salad #fyp #yummy

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Cozy Dinner Idea 🤎 Creamy Chicken Marsala 🍄 INGREDIENTS For the Chicken: • 2 large chicken breasts, sliced horizontally into 4 cutlets • Kinder’s Grilled Chicken Seasoning • Salt, to taste • ½ cup all-purpose flour • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp unsalted butter For the Marsala Sauce: • 8 oz baby bella mushrooms, sliced • 1 shallot, finely diced • 3–4 garlic cloves, minced • ¾ cup Marsala cooking wine • ¾ cup chicken broth • ½ cup heavy cream • 3–4 sprigs fresh thyme • Salt & black pepper, to taste • 1 tbsp butter (optional, for finishing) • Fresh parsley, for garnish INSTRUCTIONS 1. Season chicken cutlets on both sides with salt and Kinder’s Grilled Chicken Seasoning. Lightly coat each piece in flour, shaking off any excess. 2. Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown. Remove and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add sliced mushrooms to the remaining butter, oil, and chicken drippings. Sauté for 5–7 minutes until golden brown. 4. Add diced shallots and cook for 2 minutes. Stir in minced garlic and fresh thyme, cooking for another 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in Marsala cooking wine, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the skillet. Simmer for 3–5 minutes until reduced by half. 6. Add chicken broth and simmer for another 3–4 minutes. Reduce heat to medium-low, stir in heavy cream, and let the sauce gently simmer until slightly thickened. 7. Return chicken and any juices to the skillet. Spoon the creamy mushroom sauce over the chicken and simmer for 3–5 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally. 8. Remove thyme stems, stir in a tablespoon of butter if desired for a silky finish, and garnish with fresh parsley. #ChickenMarsala #DinnerIdeas #EasyDinnerRecipes #QuickDinner #CozyDinner

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

There are so many good recipes out there, but truthfully I’ve always had a hard time finding one that actually works for the season of life I’m in. My husband works late and I have two little girls, so weeknight dinner is on me, and most nights I just don’t have the time, the energy, or the headspace for a lot of recipes. That’s pretty much why I started making my own dinners, and I hope other moms, or honestly anyone, can appreciate them, because to me they’re actually so easy. DUMB DINNERS Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo INGREDIENTS 1 box (16 oz) orzo, uncooked 1 tub (32 oz) Panera broccoli cheddar soup 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 3 cups shredded rotisserie chicken 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper a few shakes Frank’s RedHot 1 bag (12 oz) frozen broccoli florets 1 bag (8 oz) shredded extra-sharp cheddar a big handful Cheez-Its, crushed HOW TO MAKE IT Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9×13 dish. Dump in the orzo, soup, broth, and chicken. Sprinkle on the garlic powder, pepper, and hot sauce. Dump in the frozen broccoli straight from the bag. Stir well so the orzo is under the liquid. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes. Uncover and stir. It should look loose and creamy. Stir in half the cheddar. Top with the rest, then the crushed Cheez-Its. Bake uncovered 5 more minutes. Let it sit 10 minutes before serving. Taste before adding any salt. #creatorsearchinsights #easydinnerideas #easyrecipe #easymeal #dinnerideas

✨Let’s make Cane inspired chicken tenders for dinner 😋 Chicken tenders Wet batter: Cut 2 chicken breasts in to strips Add them to a bowl along with  1 1/2 cups buttermilk 1 tsp salt 1 tbsp black pepper 2 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp paprika Mix and marinate 30 mins to 1 hour or overnight if needed.  Dry batter: Mix 2 cups APF (all purpose flour) 3 tbsp corn starch Dash of salt 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika Dunk the wet chicken strips in to the dry batter, making sure fully coated and deep fry for 8-10 mins in oil at 350F flipping half way through. Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers!!!  Tender chicken coated in a honey garlic soy sauce with sautéed peppers. Sticky, savory, and perfect over rice!!!  Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers  2 large chicken breast  Neutral oil  1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp soy 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp cornstarch  Sauce  Bell peppers, sliced (for sautéing) 1 tsp ginger paste or grated  2 tbsp garlic paste  2 tbsp honey  1/4 cup light and dark soy combined  1 tsp rice seasoning  1 tbsp hoisin sauce  1/2 tbsp oyster sauce  1/2 tsp Totole Granulated Chicken Flavor Season the chicken with neutral oil, seasonings, and cornstarch. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Cook the chicken in a skillet 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the sliced peppers until they reach your desired texture, then add the garlic paste. Pour in the sauce and simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add a 1:1 cornstarch slurry to thicken. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together until coated. Street Corn Chicken Bowls: Gut Healthy Edition 🌽 @Nature Made  Juicy spiced chicken, the most addictive green sauce you've ever made, and a zesty street corn salad. High protein, gut-healthy and paired with my daily Nature Made Probiotic + Prebiotic Fiber Gummies… weeknight approved 🫡 #partner For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp oregano, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -3 tbsp olive oil -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 lime, juiced For the Street Corn: -30 oz (850 g) corn kernels (or 4 cobs) -⅓ cup red onion, finely diced -1 fresh jalapeno, diced (deseeded) -½ avocado, cubed -¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped -⅓ cup cotija cheese (or feta), crumbled -Seasonings: 2 tsp chile lime, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp pepper -¼ cup greek yogurt -¼ cup mayonnaise -½ lime, juiced For the Aji Verde: -½ cup greek yogurt -½ cup mayonnaise  -1 small jalapeño, deseeded -1 1/2 cups cilantro, leaves and stems -4 to 5 garlic cloves -2 tsp black pepper -1 tsp salt -Juice of 1 lime Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic and lime juice. Mix well & marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. For even more flavor, char the corn in a hot skillet for 5–7 with a splash of neutral oil before mixing with the remaining street corn ingredients. Refrigerate. 3. To a food processor or blender, add all of the Aji Verde ingredients and blend until smooth & vibrant green. 4. I recommend making rice for the bowls! 2 cups of long grain white rice should do the trick. Once done, fluff with 2 tbsp olive oil, ¼ cup fresh cilantro and a splash of lime juice. 5. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat & add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden & cooked through. Set aside. 6. Assemble your bowls with the rice, chicken, street corn salad, a generous drizzle of aji verde, extra cotija, and fresh cilantro. Enjoy :)

This isn't a scene from a film. This is a heartbreaking reality that still exists in parts of Nepal. For some women and girls, getting their period means being sent away from their own home to spend the night in a small shed, away from their families. They are left to face cold nights, fear, loneliness, and the danger of snakes, insects, and wild animals—all because of a natural biological process. Menstruation should never be a reason for exclusion or shame. Take a moment and ask yourself: If it were someone you love—your daughter, your sister, your wife, or your mother—would you accept this as "tradition"? Some customs deserve to be questioned, especially when they put lives and dignity at risk. Every woman deserves to feel safe, respected, and valued, no matter what day of the month it is. Let's raise awareness, start conversations, and stand together to end harmful practices like this. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Serve and ENJOY! . . #garlicparmesan #healthyrecipes #mealprep #sheetpandinner #batchcooking

Sprout is Fauna Robotics’ small, developer-focused humanoid robot built to work safely around people in real-world spaces like labs, schools, offices, retail, and entertainment venues. It’s designed less like a shrunken factory robot and more like a “human-environment” platform: lightweight, padded/soft on the outside, and engineered to reduce impact risk with compliant control and limited joint torques. What makes Sprout interesting is the “full-stack” approach. Fauna positions it as a ready-to-build-on system where core capabilities—movement, perception, navigation, and social expression—work out of the box, so teams can spend time on applications instead of rebuilding fundamentals.  Sprout also leans into interaction: it can be directed via voice, has expressive features (like articulated eyebrows and LED facial elements), and supports things like whole-body control, grippers for manipulation, and even VR-based teleoperation within a unified hardware-software stack.  Pricing reported at launch is about $50,000, targeting researchers, universities, and builders who want a capable humanoid platform without starting from scratch.#ainews #robotics #Techtok #futuretech

🍔 VIRAL GARLIC PARMESAN CHEESEBURGERS 🧄🧀 Don’t make regular cheeseburgers again until you try them served face down in a pool of creamy garlic Parmesan sauce! 😭🔥 Ingredients For the burgers: * 1 lb ground beef (80/20) * 1 small onion, thinly sliced * Salt, pepper, garlic powder & paprika * 4 slices American cheese * 4 burger buns * Butter for toasting For the garlic Parmesan sauce: * 2 tbsp butter * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 cup heavy cream * ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp Italian seasoning * Salt & pepper to taste * Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Make the smash burgers: Divide beef into 4 portions. Add sliced onions to a hot skillet, place beef on top and smash into thin patties. Season generously. 2. Get those crispy edges: Sear until browned, flip and cook to 160°F. Top with American cheese and let it melt. 3. Make the sauce: Melt butter in a saucepan, sauté garlic until fragrant, then add heavy cream and seasonings. Simmer gently before stirring in Parmesan until smooth and creamy. 4. Toast your buns: Butter and toast until golden, then assemble your cheeseburgers. 5. Now for the best part! Pour a generous layer of warm garlic Parmesan sauce directly onto your serving plate. Cut each cheeseburger in half and place both halves cut side down directly into the sauce, allowing that cheesy goodness to soak into every bite. 6. Finish it off: Surround the burgers with crispy fries, garnish with parsley and serve immediately! PRO TIP: Keep extra garlic Parmesan sauce on the side because you’re going to want to dip EVERYTHING in it. 😂 #GarlicParmesanBurger #CheeseburgerRecipe #SmashBurgers #ViralRecipes #EasyDinnerIdeas

Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Cross posting to 4 accounts has been a little crazy and ya girl needs a breather 😮‍💨 so enjoy! ☺️  ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 If comfort food had a personality, this would be it. Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner
